subject.declared_domain: The C1 rung of the C0..C4 system ladder: INTERACTIONS -- the typed directed edges over C0 facts. The canon declares it as 'INTERACTIONS ~40k EDGES: the 10 relations (produces, consumes, derives-from, depends-on, contains, triggers, guards, governs, denies, owns)' and marks it VIEW-COMPILED. The declared domain is therefore the RELATION vocabulary; the live artifact is an edge_type population, and this card measures the distance between them.

methodology.how: C1 is view-compiled by the same globgrph derive runner that produces C0 (infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py @ec0408628a). Each discovered relationship between two node_ids is materialized as a row in the Iceberg table graph_edges carrying src_id, dst_id and edge_type (:366-369, via the _nid() resolver over the fixed key set at :215), then projected into kuzu_nessie_db as CREATE REL TABLE CloudEdge(FROM CloudNode TO CloudNode, edge_type STRING, ...) at :1451. As with C0 the producer ORIGINATES the physical edge_type vocabulary (53 distinct values live) while the rule bank DECLARES the relation vocabulary; the two are joined only by the rule bank's blocks.

composes.note: the relation vocabulary and its composites, read @5fc45ad69d. All 53 live edge_types appear somewhere in this file -- see the instrument caveat on the coverage row.
both endpoints are C0 node_ids, so C1 INHERITS C0's heterogeneous identity space and every limit on it.

coverage.universe: Every typed directed relationship the derive runner discovers between two C0 node_ids, across the same three substrate sides.
coverage.denominator: RE-MEASURED AT THIS CARDING: 58,325 edges, 53 distinct edge_types (the v1 card also read 53 -- unchanged). All 53 live edge_types appear somewhere in NFRA_ONTOLOGY_RULE_BANK.yaml @5fc45ad69d, so NONE is entirely absent from the declared vocabulary.
explicitly_out: C1 inherits every C0 coverage limit through its endpoints: an edge whose endpoint sits under one of C0's 10 UNBOUND node_types is present in the edge population but unreachable by any role-keyed traversal.
coverage.evidence: INSTRUMENT CAVEAT, stated because it changes what the 53 of 53 means: my sweep tested whether each live edge_type STRING APPEARS ANYWHERE in the rule-bank file. That can only OVER-count -- a token occurring in prose scores as named. It therefore establishes that no edge_type is ABSENT from the file; it does NOT reproduce the v1 card's stronger claim that all 53 are bound within the four NAMED blocks (#relations, #relation_composites and the two explicit-out blocks). That stronger claim is UNVERIFIED at this carding and is not asserted.

key.identity_space: The triple (src_id, edge_type, dst_id). Both endpoints live in C0's heterogeneous node_id space (ARNs, repo paths, S3 key globs, synthetic ids), so C1 INHERITS C0's identity heterogeneity and its unknown key stability.
key.key_expression: (_nid(e, 'source', 'src'), str(e.get('edge_type', '')), _nid(e, 'target', 'dst')) -- read at infra/aws/globgrph/derive_runner.py:366-369 @ec0408628a, over the fixed key set _EDGE_FIXED_KEYS at :215 which accepts either the source/target or the src/dst spelling. The triple is written to graph_edges and projected to CloudEdge at :1451.
key.evidence: THE KEY IS NOT ENFORCED, AND THIS CARD MEASURED THE CONSEQUENCE -- an arm C0's card could not run. CREATE REL TABLE CloudEdge (:1451) declares NO PRIMARY KEY, so a duplicate triple PERSISTS rather than being rejected at load. Measured live: 58,325 edges against 58,324 distinct (src_id, edge_type, dst_id) triples -- EXACTLY ONE DUPLICATE, named: arn:aws:states:us-east-1:313476888478:stateMachine:YangDataPipeline --INVOKES--> arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:313476888478:function:yang-generate-allocation-summary, count 2. The rate is 1 in 58,325 and the defect is real rather than theoretical. CONTRAST WITH C0 DELIBERATELY: C0's node_id IS a PRIMARY KEY, so its distinct==rows reading proves nothing about producer-side collisions; here there is no such mask and the collision is visible. Same producer, opposite evidential situation.

failure_mode.returns_on_failure: An EMPTY RESULT SET, or a SILENTLY DOUBLE-COUNTED path. A traversal that crosses the duplicated edge counts it twice with no diagnostic; a traversal that misses an edge returns nothing distinguishable from the relationship not existing.
silent_degrade_paths: the one duplicate triple double-counts any path or aggregate crossing it -- a count over that state machine's INVOKES fan-out is wrong by one and reads clean
an edge whose endpoint is under a C0 UNBOUND node_type is invisible to role-keyed traversal while being present in the edge table
an edge_type present in the file but not BOUND in a named block would score as covered by this card's instrument -- see the coverage caveat
failure_mode.evidence: The duplicate is measured and named above. The C0-inheritance paths follow from C0's own measured 76.7% role coverage at the same vintage.

verdict.why: Every row is worked and carries basis, evidence and owner, so this is not INCOMPLETE; it is usable as load-bearing substrate within stated limits, so QUALIFIED rather than SOUND. Four limits bound the use: (1) ONE DUPLICATE EDGE TRIPLE EXISTS AND IS NAMED -- CloudEdge has no primary key, so any aggregate crossing that edge is wrong by one and reads clean; (2) C1 INHERITS every C0 coverage limit through its endpoints, including the 23.3% of nodes outside the role mapping; (3) the 53-of-53 vocabulary reading comes from a substring sweep that can only over-count -- the stronger named-block claim is UNVERIFIED here and not asserted; (4) determinism and key stability are UNEXERCISED and marked unknown. NOT CLAIMED: that the 53 edge_types are correctly bound, that the duplicate is the only integrity defect (only THIS arm was run), or that a 02:00Z full re-derive was observed.

forward_disposition.evidence: NONE -- basis is absent, the designed state at carding time. A SECOND PASS IS OWED by a seat with authority to retire and no stake in this subject. This card DESCRIBES; it does not decide. set_by is null BY CONSTRUCTION (the CCY-F1 defect), and .tools/substrate-card-check.py refuses set_by == carded_by.
